name: The Homely Hearth, Common Room
desc1: This room is nearly filled with people laughing, talking, and
desc2: eating at the long tables. The smells of strong ale and freshly cooked
desc3: meat tantalize your nose, and your eyes boggle at the variety of races
desc4: intermingling here. At the eastern end of the room is a huge fireplace
desc5: almost 10 feet wide, and tall enough to stand inside. Various carvings
desc6: adorn the mantlepiece, and a crossed shield and spear hang in a place
desc7: of honour. To the south, you can see a cloakroom.
